description: This file defines a custom Dashlet class for displaying Project Tasks within the SuiteCRM platform. It extends the DashletGeneric class, loads configuration data, and overrides the buildWhere method to filter tasks that are not yet complete.

classes.name: MyProjectTaskDashlet
classes.description: A custom Dashlet for listing Project Tasks with filtering capabilities, extending the generic Dashlet class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Dashlet, loads configuration, sets default title if none specified, and initializes seedBean for project tasks.

methods.name: buildWhere
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to add a condition that filters out completed tasks (percent_complete != 100).
